ruler.rule: chao 3 = median of all frames; chao 5 = p90 of single first-tone frames; chao 1 = p10 of single third-tone frames (computeRangeHalvesFromExtremes, quarter-semitone rounding); semitonesToChao clamps at 1 and 5
ruler.source: 357 newer textbook clips, final listener (brief 42), per-clip gate, tone window frames, creak (> 10 st under the middle) left out

ruler.gate: per clip: noiseFloor = max(p10 frame RMS, 1e-4, 0.1 x median voiced RMS / rmsMult)
